hook: A body surfaced off Atlantic City in 1981, waiting 45 years for a name.

sections.voiceover: A body surfaced off Atlantic City in 1981, waiting 45 years for a name.
b_roll: Archival photo of Atlantic City coastline in 1981
Vintage map of New Jersey coastline

sections.voiceover: Recreational boaters spotted the remains 1 mile offshore near Raleigh Avenue on May 22. Where did retired Coast Guard officer Glen Burbage vanish?
b_roll: Historical photograph of Atlantic Ocean water
Archival map pointing to Raleigh Avenue in Atlantic City
Vintage photograph of a commercial flight

sections.voiceover: Ramapo College of New Jersey Investigative Genetic Genealogy Center joined New Jersey State Police on the case.
b_roll: Close-up shot of an old police case file

sections.voiceover: Ramapo College and New Jersey State Police finally matched the profile. Genetic genealogy identified the floating remains as Glen Napoleon Burbage. Advanced DNA testing ended 45 years of silence.
b_roll: Exterior shot of Ramapo College campus
Seal of the New Jersey State Police
Laboratory workstation with DNA sequencing equipment

sections.voiceover: New Jersey State Police returned Glen Napoleon Burbage his identity after forty-five years.
b_roll: Portrait photograph of a U.S. Coast Guard officer
